revision: v71 objective/definitions unchanged; take best of same4 annealing starts, then up to3 deterministic coordinate sweeps. For each group evaluate every inventory syllable, swapping if occupied or replacing if unused; accept only strict objective improvement. No oracle initialization or test selection.
old_diagnosis: Compare v71 fitted score with planted-map score where all training syllables in inventory; count unreachable true syllables, unseen-test coverage ceiling and segmentation invariants. Refine old keys only as diagnosis, retain original failures.
definitions: Check round-trip and one-vowel-nucleus invariants, and a small fixed spelling-example list. These are implementation checks, not independent phonological labels. Encoding/decoding use same definitions, so semantic correctness of syllables remains unqualified. No revised syllabifier selected from outcomes.
fresh_source: Latin.xml Bible; distinct work from v71 source, previously used elsewhere in project, fresh to this syllable pipeline. Exclude LiberJuratus.txt as a Latin control because opening passage is English. No claim of period/genre matching.
fresh_allocation: First12000 raw words train syllable model. Raw offsets20000/22000/24000 each1200words: first900yield first300 retained fitting words; final300yield first20retained test words. Compare fitting first100 vs300 on identical test. Stop if support insufficient; no resampling. Same ciphertext key percase bothsizes.
gate: For each size/method all3 fresh cases coverage>=.8,resolvedsyllableaccuracy>=.9,wholewordrecovery>=.8. Freeze all candidate mappings before applying heldout. Report within-source fresh control, not successful cross-work model transfer. Voynich remains closed regardless until result reviewed.
limits: Higher sample size combines context/coverage; original objective is within-word syllable bigrams only, does not model cross-word syntax. Restricted definitions and sparse inventory may remain obstacles.
